quest.title: The Oni's Pride
quest.description: After Daisuke points out the inconsistencies in his story, Arataki Itto is forced to reveal to you that he is currently acting to protect the blue oni. To ascertain the truth, you agree to set out with Itto once again.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x700, Primogem x60, Mora x44000, Guide to Elegance x5, Hero's Wit x5, Mystic Enhancement Ore x10

talks.objective: Go to check on the victim

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Yo! You must be Masato?

dialogues.speaker: Masato
dialogues.text: A—An oni!? Oh no, not another one...

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Oh — uh, yeah, not the one that robbed you though. So chill. I contacted you before, remember? I need your help.

dialogues.speaker: Masato
dialogues.text: Oh, right... Sorry, I'm still a bit on edge after the incident. Ahem, so anyway here's what happened. I was just out transporting some goods when a group of ronin suddenly attacked me.

dialogues.speaker: Masato
dialogues.text: It's not the first time that's happened to me. Usually, you just hand over some Mora and they'll leave you alone. At least you don't lose your goods that way.

dialogues.speaker: Masato
dialogues.text: But this time was different. They weren't willing to talk things over, instead, they took my things and then started coming for me.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh!? That's totally uncalled for!

dialogues.speaker: Masato
dialogues.text: I got down on my knees and begged. Said I had a family to care for and that my business is our only livelihood.

dialogues.speaker: Masato
dialogues.text: Then I saw that there was an oni among the group. I thought he was gonna be the one to finish me off.

dialogues.speaker: Masato
dialogues.text: But instead, he stopped the others and told them to let me go.

response.speaker: Masato
response.text: Yeah. That got them all arguing with each other. His cohort said that I was sure to retaliate if they released me.

response.speaker: Masato
response.text: But the young oni was insistent that they shouldn't lay a finger on me. Things got real heated — I thought they were gonna come to blows.

response.speaker: Masato
response.text: Luckily, they let me escape with my life in the end, and I scrambled to get myself here, where I'd be safe. *sigh* I never want to set foot outside of here again.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: So he'll steal, but he won't harm people. Hmph, seems he has some sort of standards.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Did he say why they were robbing you?

response.speaker: Masato
response.text: ...Surely it was Mora, right? What else could they have wanted with me?

response.speaker: Masato
response.text: I mean, I can't say for sure. It's not like I asked... But what I did hear them say was, "The goods are worth more than the merchant's life," or something like that.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Ugh, that idiot oni...

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Do you have any idea where they went after they robbed you?

response.speaker: Masato
response.text: I have no clue, but I think they're pretty active in the Tatarasuna area.

response.speaker: Masato
response.text: You aren't gonna go after them, are you? Seriously, I'd advise against it... There are too many of them, and they're all heavily armed.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Ah, don't worry, it's just a bunch of no-name scumbags. I got a whole laundry list of scores to settle with them.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: If these two islands are where they tend to hang around, we're sure to run into them at <color=#00E1FFFF>Nazuchi Beach</color> sooner or later.

choices.text: So was there friction within the group?

talks.objective: Lie in wait at Nazuchi Beach for the ronin to show up

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: They gotta pass through here some time. So let's just hang tight for a while.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: If I'm not mistaken, they'll be showing up any time now.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah, things might get a little rough, so we'd better be prepared.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, here they come!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Yeah, there they are. And one of them has horns.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Alright, it's go time. Let's get 'em!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whew, we managed to save everyone, but...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What about Itto and Takuya? Paimon hopes they're alright...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uhh...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Look! It's Itto and Takuya!

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Ugh, that's gonna hurt tomorrow...

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: What's up with the looks on your faces? I said we'd be okay, didn't I?

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: I'm sure I'd be looking a whole lot sharper right now if it wasn't for that brutal bean attack of yours earlier.

choices.text: I'm just happy you made it out alive!

response.speaker: Takuya
response.text: Why...

response.speaker: Takuya
response.text: Wh—Why would you do this for me?

response.speaker: Takuya
response.text: I'm the guilty one here... I don't deserve this.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Because we are oni, that's why. We share the same blood, brother.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Our parents and their parents before them never taught us that it was okay to abandon family in need.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: ...I just wish you'd come to find me sooner.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: If you knew about me all along, then you should've just come and asked me for help. I never would have dreamed of turning you away.

response.speaker: Takuya
response.text: The blue oni disappeared so that they wouldn't bring trouble to the crimson oni. If I came to you for help, wouldn't that just undo everything the blue oni have done?

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Not to me! I've always respected the blue oni for their sacrifice. Nothing they did was in vain.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: It's only because of them that we have survived to see today, and built a world where oni and humans can live side by side.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Honestly, everything that I have now, I owe to the blue oni. And lemme tell you, the Inazuma of today wouldn't see you as a villain just because of the color of your horns.

response.speaker: Takuya
response.text: You say all that, but... in spite of everything, you're barely getting by...

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Hahaha, that's just how I roll, man.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: You remember the pact, don't ya? We're not supposed to suck up to the humans. We're supposed to earn their respect.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Every member of the Arataki Gang's had a tough time trying to fit in.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Take Akira, for example, he snores like you wouldn't believe... Or Genta, he's got a serious temper problem... And Mamoru, well, he's colorblind...

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Even Granny Oni, she got that name for taking me in as a kid. We're all rejects and outcasts in some way, but we don't care.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: You wanna talk about pride? Well, in our gang, we're proud to welcome anyone who's been through adversity with open arms.

response.speaker: Takuya
response.text: But... I...

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Ah, don't worry! The Arataki Gang's already a bunch of misfits. You really think you could cramp our style?

response.speaker: Ishizaki
response.text: We've dealt with the Kairagi and the people they took captive. I assume the two of you are finished talking?

response.speaker: Ishizaki
response.text: Takuya, based on the findings of our investigation... I hereby announce that you are officially under arrest for forceful seizure of people and property. Please do not attempt to resist.

response.speaker: Ishizaki
response.text: All stolen articles will be reclaimed. That means we'll be seizing all the goods you passed on to your kin.

response.speaker: Takuya
response.text: N—No, please don't! Without those goods, they'll...

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: It's alright, Takuya. Those goods never belonged to us anyway.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Don't worry, I'll help take care of your kin. Now that I know the situation, I'll personally make sure that they never suffer again.

response.speaker: Ishizaki
response.text: Might wanna put your grand plans on hold there. You're under arrest too, for numerous assaults on Tenryou Commission officers.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Oh, hehe... I guess I forgot about that.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: But no worries! I'll put my gang on the case. My boys will take good care of the blue oni...

response.speaker: Ishizaki
response.text: Yeah, we've already arrested them, too.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Oh, right. Yeah, uh...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: *sigh* That's what they get for resisting the Tenryou Commission.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: I guess it's up to you then, Traveler. Could ya be a pal and tell Granny Oni about the blue oni situation?

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Thanks... and thanks for sticking with me to the end. Once I'm out of the slammer, I'll find a way to make it all up to ya.

response.speaker: Ishizaki
response.text: As for you two, lending them your aid when you knew full well they were in the wrong means that the culpability extends to you too.

response.speaker: Ishizaki
response.text: But, given your unique circumstances, and in light of the complexity of this case, we won't press charges this time.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe, sorry for the trouble.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Hey, wait! "Unique circumstances"? Are these guys, like, a big deal or something?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Nope, it's nothing like that.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Hahaha, c—cool, 'cause I was gonna say, y'know... I'm kind of a big deal myself. You know...

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Alright, see you next time... Whenever that will be!

choices.text: Now's your chance to clean up your act.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Yeah, I know the drill, this isn't my first time... and it probably won't be my last.

choices.text: We didn't want to make things too easy for you.
Itto said he could take care of it.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Hey! Don't even think about runnin'!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: It's me. Arataki Itto, descendant of the crimson oni!
Hmph, I know who you are.
From the day we are born, every blue oni knows their purpose. We all know our fate is one of self-sacrifice.

dialogues.speaker: Takuya
dialogues.text: But what about the crimson oni, hmm? You don't know anything about us... Not our miserable history, or any of our names. Mine's Takuya, by the way. But you don't even care, do you?

dialogues.speaker: Takuya
dialogues.text: Because those who get sacrificed should be forgotten, right?

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: No, you're wrong. I never knew that the blue oni had survived to this day — and the moment I found out, I was determined that I would find you.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Since you remember the pact between our two factions, I assume you also remember the pride we share as oni.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: So my question is, how could a proud oni like yourself go and abuse the weak and plunder the innocent? Why break the oath that our kind swore all those years ago?

dialogues.speaker: Takuya
dialogues.text: Hahaha!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Huh? What's so funny!?

dialogues.speaker: Takuya
dialogues.text: Heh, who are you to talk about pride and oaths with me?

dialogues.speaker: Takuya
dialogues.text: The blue oni gave up everything! Just so the crimson oni could live peacefully in human society!

dialogues.speaker: Takuya
dialogues.text: But let me ask you, Arataki Itto, what exactly do you contribute to human society?

dialogues.speaker: Takuya
dialogues.text: You're a blundering fool who can't hold down a real job, a laughingstock of the town, and worse still, you let them get your Vision during the Vision Hunt Decree. Protecting the oni pride? Hah! You wouldn't know how if you tried!

dialogues.speaker: Takuya
dialogues.text: You're a disgrace to the oni kind!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Hey, come on, none of that stuff's a big deal, I mean... heh, y—you're, uh, really hangin' me out to dry here, man...

dialogues.speaker: Takuya
dialogues.text: Since when do you care what other people think? You just do whatever you want. It's not like anyone can stop you.

dialogues.speaker: Takuya
dialogues.text: But do you have any idea of the kind of life my kin and I have lived while you've been hanging around in human society?

dialogues.speaker: Takuya
dialogues.text: We were cut off from the rest of the world. We severed all contact with it, and since then we've had no place to live, no stable source of food...

dialogues.speaker: Takuya
dialogues.text: No clothing, no medicine, nothing! Besides the oath we swore to uphold and our so-called oni pride, we had nothing!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: So that's why you joined a band of thieves?

dialogues.speaker: Takuya
dialogues.text: That's right. Why should I accept that life? Is holding fast to a worthless oath supposed to help me provide for my family and friends?

dialogues.speaker: Takuya
dialogues.text: I've abandoned our oni pride, it's meaningless. I want to live.

dialogues.speaker: Takuya
dialogues.text: I've given everything that I've stolen from humans to my community. What I've taken will at least keep them from starving and ease their pain.

dialogues.speaker: Takuya
dialogues.text: That's what matters most to me.

choices.text: You don't need to go to such extremes.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah! And besides, the blue oni sacrificed themselves so that oni could be accepted as part of human society!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: If people see oni causing trouble again, then that'll defeat the whole purpose of the sacrifice you made!

response.speaker: Takuya
response.text: Hmph, you make a good point. But Arataki Itto's the one who needs to get that into his thick skull.

response.speaker: Takuya
response.text: The blue oni are the bad guys, so we're expected to do bad things. Our actions won't tarnish the reputation of the crimson oni...

response.speaker: Takuya
response.text: Unless, of course, this bonehead decides it'd be a great idea to take all the blame for himself, completely destroying the trust between humans and the crimson oni in the process...

response.speaker: Takuya
response.text: He's the one that's wasted the sacrifice we've made.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Huh!? I only had to do that because of you! I couldn't just stand back and let the Tenryou Commission drag you away!

response.speaker: Takuya
response.text: You should get your priorities straight!

response.speaker: Takuya
response.text: The blue oni are history, alright!? Forget about us! The crimson oni are the ones who must live on!

response.speaker: Takuya
response.text: Why couldn't you have just stayed out of this!?

response.speaker: Ishizaki
response.text: There they are! Seize them!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh no! It's the Tenryou Commission!

response.speaker: Takuya
response.text: Ugh, forget it! This was a waste of time anyway.

response.speaker: Takuya
response.text: Look, I don't expect you to understand me. But you could at least take a look in the mirror sometime.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey! Heyyy!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: He got away! Uh oh, we need to get out of here, too!

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: We can't get caught here.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Looks like I'm up to bat. Just wait here, and we'll escape together when the time's right.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Whatever you do, don't attack any of the Tenryou Commission or they'll be after you too.

choices.text: That doesn't actually solve the root problem.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Alright, you're all free to go now! Quick, get to safety!

dialogues.speaker: Misuzu
dialogues.text: Sorry, but have you seen our little boy? We're awfully worried about him!

dialogues.speaker: Sugimoto
dialogues.text: Calm down, dear. We don't even know if he was taken here or not.

dialogues.speaker: Misuzu
dialogues.text: B—But... Oh, my little Daisuke...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, you must be Daisuke's parents!

dialogues.speaker: Misuzu
dialogues.text: Yes, that's right! Have you seen him? Where is he? Is he all right?

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Don't worry, he's safe and sound. Someone's looking after him now on Yashiori Island. Here, lemme show you on the map.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: He's been worried about you, I bet he'll be relieved to see you.

dialogues.speaker: Misuzu
dialogues.text: You were the one who saved him? Oh, thank you, thank you!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: He's the one you should be thanking.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Hahaha, no need to thank me. It's my pleasure, really. It's just who I am... it's what I do.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Before you go calling me a hero, lemme ask you this: Wouldn't any other self-respecting guy who saw another person in danger have done the exact same thing?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Really... Just one little compliment and it goes straight to his head...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why did they seize so many people?

dialogues.speaker: Sugimoto
dialogues.text: *sigh* These vagrants are insatiable. They'll do anything for money.

dialogues.speaker: Sugimoto
dialogues.text: No one dares stand up to them for fear of what they might do...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: W—Would they really do anything drastic?

dialogues.speaker: Sugimoto
dialogues.text: Um... No, actually, because one of the guys — the one with oni horns on his head — has always shielded us so far.

dialogues.speaker: Sugimoto
dialogues.text: Oh, in fact, his horns look just like the ones this guy has!

dialogues.speaker: Misuzu
dialogues.text: At night, he would secretly bring us food and water. I don't understand what he was trying to do...

dialogues.speaker: Misuzu
dialogues.text: Are you a friend of his? Or perhaps a relative?

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Uh, relative, I guess.

dialogues.speaker: Misuzu
dialogues.text: Oh, maybe there's something secretly troubling him? He seemed different from the rest of the gang... They seem like heartless crooks, but I'd say he comes across more like a confused child who made some poor choices.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Lemme put it this way... There are a few things he needs to straighten out in his head, and I'm here to point him in the right direction.

dialogues.speaker: Misuzu
dialogues.text: I'm glad to hear that. He's lucky to have family like you.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Hehe, don't worry, he'll be in my trusty hands. I'll help him see the light.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Anyway, you should scram, it's still not safe here.

dialogues.speaker: Misuzu
dialogues.text: Yes, thanks again. You've rescued our entire family... we are indebted to you.

talks.objective: Square off against the Tenryou Commission members

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Man, they really came out in force today. I'm kinda flattered the Tenryou Commission sent so many...

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: But I still haven't completely recovered from the bean attack earlier... I'm starting to lose my edge here.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why don't you let us explain the situation to them?

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: No, no way!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: All that would do is send them after our blue oni friend instead. But, I have to settle things with him first, man to man!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Then what should we do!? The Tenryou Commission's about to arrest you!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Ugh, no choice but to keep kicking some Tenryou butt!

dialogues.speaker: Akira
dialogues.text: Hey Boss! Thought you'd have all the fun without us, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Genta
dialogues.text: Granny Oni sent us. We're here to lend a hand!

dialogues.speaker: Mamoru
dialogues.text: Maybe we can't take 'em, but we can sure slow 'em down. Now's your chance — go!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Hey! I told you to stay outta this one!

dialogues.speaker: Akira
dialogues.text: Well, we're in it now. C'mon, there's no time!

dialogues.speaker: Genta
dialogues.text: Go do what you gotta do, Boss!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Hmph, alright then!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Watch yourselves. Soon as I'm done, I'm coming back for you!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: C'mon, you two! Time to roll!

dialogues.speaker: Ishizaki
dialogues.text: Don't let them get away! After them!

dialogues.speaker: Mamoru
dialogues.text: Hey! You guys want some of this!? There's plenty to go around!

dialogues.speaker: Genta
dialogues.text: Run for it, Boss!

talks.objective: Follow the footprints and chase Takuya

dialogues.speaker: Granny Oni
dialogues.text: Just leave everything to me now.

dialogues.speaker: Granny Oni
dialogues.text: It looks like Granny Oni's about to get a few more oni to look after.

dialogues.speaker: Masato
dialogues.text: I still think you should leave it alone... they're too dangerous.

dialogues.speaker: Masato
dialogues.text: Never mind the goods, I'm lucky just to have escaped with my life.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Ah! Hidden entrance! Yes! Alright! I think we just found their hideout.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: This is gonna be where they keep all the people they took.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon thinks Takuya's probably in there as well.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Before we go in, I have a question.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Huh? Oh, fire away.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Did you really understand where Takuya was coming from?

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Heh, of course I did! C'mon, I'm not that dumb...

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: But it takes a world-class blockhead like Takuya to think his ideas are actually gonna work.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: So I'm here to save him, no matter what!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Alright, that's good to hear.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? What were you two talking about? Are you keeping Paimon in the dark again?

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Hahahaha, let's go!

talks.objective: Ascertain the situation with Arataki Itto
Go deeper into the ronin hideout
Defeat the ronin guarding this place

dialogues.speaker: Nogata
dialogues.text: Bet you think you've won, don't ya?

dialogues.speaker: Nogata
dialogues.text: Haha, so naive! This is my home turf!

dialogues.speaker: Nogata
dialogues.text: I'll let you in on a little secret. A long time ago, I picked up this rare paper charm. It's very precious to me.

dialogues.speaker: Nogata
dialogues.text: What makes it so special is that if you tear one piece, the other piece starts tearing too.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Uh, news flash, don't care about your little origami obsession.

dialogues.speaker: Nogata
dialogues.text: You'd better stay where you are and let me finish!

dialogues.speaker: Nogata
dialogues.text: Aren't you curious what the other piece is used for?

dialogues.speaker: Nogata
dialogues.text: I'll tell you. It's now the critical component of a mechanism, and when it gets torn, this place goes up in smoke! Yeah. The whole hideout is rigged with explosives and ready to blow.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wha— You're gonna blow this whole place up!?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You'll get yourself killed too.

dialogues.speaker: Nogata
dialogues.text: Oh, don't worry about me. I made sure that I've got an escape route. The rest of you, though... you're gonna be buried deep among the rubble!

dialogues.speaker: Nogata
dialogues.text: You've had your fun. Now it's goodbye!

dialogues.speaker: Nogata
dialogues.text: ...Huh?

dialogues.speaker: Nogata
dialogues.text: My paper charm! Wh—Where's my paper charm!?

dialogues.speaker: Takuya
dialogues.text: I'm sorry, are you looking for this?

dialogues.speaker: Nogata
dialogues.text: Yes, that's— But when did you...

dialogues.speaker: Takuya
dialogues.text: I snatched it earlier, to stop you from doing anything hasty.

dialogues.speaker: Nogata
dialogues.text: Why you... And now you're going to betray me!?

dialogues.speaker: Takuya
dialogues.text: You're one to talk. What about burying everyone here? If you ask me, that sounds like you've already betrayed our agreement, no?

dialogues.speaker: Nogata
dialogues.text: Agh! Just give it here!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: You done talking now? You sure? Great, 'cause I am done listening.

dialogues.speaker: Nogata
dialogues.text: Ughhhh...

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Great work, Takuya. You arrived in the nick of time.

dialogues.speaker: Takuya
dialogues.text: Stay away from me!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Huh!?

dialogues.speaker: Takuya
dialogues.text: I said stay away, or I'll tear the paper charm!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Hey! Okay, okay... fine. Just calm down. What are you doing!?

dialogues.speaker: Takuya
dialogues.text: Just because I won't let him blow this place to bits doesn't mean that I won't do it myself!

dialogues.speaker: Takuya
dialogues.text: Unless you wanna get buried, then leave this place, now! Take everyone here and get out!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Heh, you won't go through with it.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: If you were that cruel, then why bother protecting every person you've come across, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Takuya
dialogues.text: I'm not here to reason with you! Go! Just get out of here!

dialogues.speaker: Takuya
dialogues.text: This sacrifice is mine to make, mine alone! Why couldn't you just stay out of it!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: No one needs to sacrifice themselves!

dialogues.speaker: Takuya
dialogues.text: Alright, then you tell me, what am I supposed to do!?

dialogues.speaker: Takuya
dialogues.text: I've tarnished our oni pride and abandoned our ancestors' oath. Only sacrifice can restore my pride now!

dialogues.speaker: Takuya
dialogues.text: I chose this path so I could provide for my fellow oni. I was ready to die from the very beginning.

dialogues.speaker: Takuya
dialogues.text: This is between us blue oni! But you... If it wasn't for you, everything would have worked out perfectly!

dialogues.speaker: Ishizaki
dialogues.text: They're here! We won't let them slip away this time!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh oh, there's nowhere else to run!

dialogues.speaker: Takuya
dialogues.text: Hey, Tenryou Commission! I'm the one you're looking for! I did it, I'm behind everything! Arataki Itto is innocent!

dialogues.speaker: Takuya
dialogues.text: You're the ones in charge of detaining criminals in human society, right? I'm sure you can tell who the criminal is here!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh! It's like he's trying to re-enact the fairytale! Sacrificing himself for the crimson oni...

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Ignore him, he doesn't know what he's talking about! It's me you've been looking for, and here I am! How're you ever going to report back without capturing me!

dialogues.speaker: Takuya
dialogues.text: Grr! Stop fooling around, Itto!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Listen Takuya, sacrificing yourself won't solve anything.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Your sacrifice can't protect me or your fellow oni. And giving up your life isn't gonna make theirs any longer.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Sacrificing yourself is one way to escape your fate, but the only one you'll be setting free is yourself.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Listen to me! You wanna be the tough guy, huh? Well, this is the coward's way out! Don't let your sacrifice stain our oni pride!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: The blue oni have been scraping the bottom of the barrel all these years, so let's give them a new beginning.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: We've made mistakes, but we can make up for them.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Fate hasn't been kind to the oni? Well then, let's tear it up and start over!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: But before any of that can happen, you need to get yourself behind me and forget about all of that self-sacrifice stuff!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Now, let's go. But we're not done talking about this. Takuya!!!

talks.objective: Meet up with Takuya and Arataki Itto
Tell Granny Oni everything that happened

dialogues.speaker: Granny Oni
dialogues.text: Ahh yes, that does sounds like my Itto.

dialogues.speaker: Daisuke
dialogues.text: So... did they take Uncle Itto away?

dialogues.speaker: Misuzu
dialogues.text: Yes, they did. But don't be too upset, Daisuke. We will have the chance to see him again.

dialogues.speaker: Misuzu
dialogues.text: He and his gang may have acted recklessly, but the fact remains that he still helped us.

dialogues.speaker: Daisuke
dialogues.text: Yeah, I knew it! Uncle Itto helped us, and he's awesome!

dialogues.speaker: Granny Oni
dialogues.text: Now don't get any ideas, Daisuke. Itto is a far cry from "awesome." He still caused a lot of trouble for a lot of people.

dialogues.speaker: Granny Oni
dialogues.text: If you ask me, I'd say he's like one of those little Onikabuto you kids are playing with all the time.

dialogues.speaker: Granny Oni
dialogues.text: Though he looks fierce on the outside, he has a kind heart. He's not a delinquent, but he will never back down from a fight.

dialogues.speaker: Daisuke
dialogues.text: Uh, I don't really get it, but it sounds like a compliment. I can't wait for my next beetle fight with Uncle Itto!

dialogues.speaker: Sugimoto
dialogues.text: Thank you, Granny, for taking care of our little boy. I hope that Itto and his friends will be released as quickly as possible.

dialogues.speaker: Granny Oni
dialogues.text: Yes, you needn't worry. The officials in the Tenryou Commission will certainly exercise sound judgment.

dialogues.speaker: Sugimoto
dialogues.text: It's time we started heading back. We'll be sure to visit again soon.

dialogues.speaker: Granny Oni
dialogues.text: Ah, I'm glad that everything was resolved in the end. Things were looking quite dire, but now the future looks bright. Wonderful, wonderful.

dialogues.speaker: Granny Oni
dialogues.text: As for the blue oni, just leave them to me. If there's one thing an old granny like myself can do, it's caring for others.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Do you need our help?

dialogues.speaker: Granny Oni
dialogues.text: Haha, no, no. Go on ahead, I'm sure you have other adventures beckoning.

dialogues.speaker: Granny Oni
dialogues.text: Besides, once Itto is released, he'll be here to help me.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is he always like this?

dialogues.speaker: Granny Oni
dialogues.text: Oh, yes... And you know what, I think that's what makes him adorable, wouldn't you agree? Hehe.

dialogues.speaker: Granny Oni
dialogues.text: He does whatever he puts his mind to... He's sincere, brave, and determined.

dialogues.speaker: Granny Oni
dialogues.text: Back when I took him in, everyone thought I was most unusual indeed. They started calling me Granny Oni.

dialogues.speaker: Granny Oni
dialogues.text: But I've never been ashamed of this name. On the contrary, I'm quite proud of it.

dialogues.speaker: Granny Oni
dialogues.text: Because Itto is my pride and joy.

talks.objective: Square off against the Tenryou Commission members

dialogues.speaker: Daisuke
dialogues.text: Please, you gotta believe me! Uncle Itto didn't do anything wrong, he's not a bad guy!

dialogues.speaker: Granny Oni
dialogues.text: I'll take care of Daisuke. No need to worry, dear. Everything will be fine.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Okay... Looks like we lost 'em

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Hang in there, homies... Hang in there...

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: As boss of the Arataki Gang, getting rescued by my own boys feels... pretty humiliating.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: I promise to never let you down, boys! Alright, we've got some footprints to follow. Let's find Takuya!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It was real touching and all, what they did, but those few guys weren't much of a gang...

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Hey, it takes Mora to run a gang, okay? They're all I've got for now.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Huh? Is it just me, or are there more and more footprints here?

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: At least we know we're headed the right way. Let's see what else we can find ahead.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: A wrecked cart and some goods...

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Look alive, we've got company!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Seems they definitely don't want us going any further.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Let's see what's waiting for us up ahead.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Huh, besides the footprints, there are other signs of life here, too. Must be plenty going on around here...

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Let's investigate. They couldn't have just disappeared into thin air... unless they're all ninjas or something.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Heh, a child that made some poor choices...

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Anyway, let's get going. While we still have time.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, he's pretty...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Weird, but at least he's not a bad guy.
